visualCharacteristics.structure: intro (h2 + p) + Similar / Lighter / Darker segmented control (only authored palettes) switching color cards
visualCharacteristics.layout: Mobile/tablet: intro, full-width white pill segmented control with a sliding black active pill, then a 2-up grid of square color cards (8px rounded). From 1024px: intro columns 1-6 with control right-aligned (columns 9-12, 10-12 from 1200px); scroll-snap carousel of 420px square cards (24px rounded) bleeding past the container edges, prev/next + 01/06 counter. Card name (bold) + code top-left, dark/light text via getColorTheme. At most 6 cards per palette.

contentPattern: Row 1 (optional): [h2 + p intro]. Rows 2..n: [palette label: Similar | Lighter | Darker] | [ul of color links whose text is CODE|Name|HEX]. Rows may be omitted (e.g. no Lighter); links not in CODE|Name|HEX form show their link text.
